roster.title: Execution fleet roster
roster.subtitle: Global execution identities Bruna may invoke in any project, differentiated by provider and role. Redacted data only — never a credential or token.
roster.error: Could not load the execution roster.

chart.title: Team utilization
chart.subtitle: Tasks completed by each agent (accumulated) — where the team's throughput sits right now.
chart.empty: The team has not completed any tasks yet.

filteredEmpty.title: No specialists found
filteredEmpty.body: No specialist matches the selected filters. Adjust the state or team.

noProject.body: Select or create a project to see the agent team.

empty.title: No agents allocated
empty.body: No agent has been invoked in this project yet. The global fleet above remains available; this area shows only effective project activity.

fleetTree.title: Global fleet organization chart
fleetTree.help: Bruna coordinates all identities below. They may be invoked in any project; project activity and global availability are distinct concepts.
fleetTree.zeroSource: Source: persisted tasks and attempts attributable to the identity. Without an attributable link, the value is zero.

tasksCompleted.label: Tasks completed
tasksCompleted.help: Accumulated total of tasks completed by the agent (metrics.tasksCompleted).

approvedInReview.label: Approved in review
approvedInReview.help: Tasks assigned to the agent that are currently in the Done column.

rework.label: Rework
rework.help: Agent tasks in the Corrections column plus failed attempts.

detail.skillsEmpty: No skills associated with the definition.
detail.toolsEmpty: No tools allowed in the definition.

route.title: Model and routing
route.reasonOverride: The model was selected by a human override recorded on the agent instance.
route.reasonDefault: Routing automatically applied the definition default model.
route.effortUnavailable: the model does not publish a compatible mapping
route.effortAutomatic: Automatic according to policy and capability
route.estimatedImpactCost: Base rate per 1k tokens: {{input}} input and {{output}} output; final cost depends on actual usage.
route.estimatedImpactLocal: No monetary rate published; latency and capacity depend on the local/provider environment.
route.unresolved: Model not found in the catalog

detail.historyEmpty: No recent audit events or attempts.
